proposed_rules.trigger: A page URL matches the /integrations/integrations-<partner>-knack pattern and its tree shows the recurring sequence: hero title, 'How Knack Flows Work' intro+demo, 3-step walkthrough, automation-templates grid, feature-highlight panel, triggers/actions table, CTA link, about-partner text, related content.
proposed_rules.decision: Model this recurring sequence as a fixed page template with a stable section/block order, rather than re-deriving block boundaries independently on every partner page.
proposed_rules.rationale: Templatizing keeps ~90 partner-integration pages consistent and authorable. Rejected alternative: treat each integration page as bespoke content with independently-derived sections, which would produce inconsistent block naming/boundaries across otherwise identical pages.

provenance.evidence: C95 rc1c2c1-c14 matches the same sequence seen in C96-C99

proposed_rules.trigger: A sizable childless leaf node (no text, no bg tag) sits inside a heading+text intro section where a product walkthrough demo/video is expected.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as a video/embed block placeholder; confirm actual media (video vs. animated screenshot) via Phase 2 DOM/src extraction since the visual-tree capture does not render <video>/canvas contents.
proposed_rules.rationale: The blank region recurs at a consistent size and position across all integration pages in this cluster, strongly indicating unrendered media rather than empty content.
